mapper.select: SELECT sdu.department_id, sd.name AS departmentName, sdu.user_id, sui.user_name, sd.code FROM sys_department_user sdu INNER JOIN sys_user_info sui ON sdu.user_id = sui.uid INNER JOIN sys_department sd ON sdu.department_id = sd.id WHERE sui.delete_state=1

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY level) AS level, dept.id as deptId, dept.name as deptName, dept.create_time, dept.update_time, dept.parent_id, dept.type, sdu.user_id, sui.user_name, #{userId} as currentUserId FROM ( -- This subquery selects all ancestors of the given department ID using a recursive CTE WITH RECURSIVE department_tree AS ( SELECT id, name, remark, create_time, update_time, parent_id, type, 1 AS level FROM sys_department WHERE id = (SELECT department_id from sys_department_user where user_id = #{userId} limit 1) -- Replace with the desired department ID UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.name, d.remark, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.parent_id, d.type, dt.level + 1 FROM sys_department d JOIN department_tree dt ON d.id = dt.parent_id ) SELECT * FROM department_tree ) AS dept LEFT JOIN sys_department_user sdu on dept.id = sdu.department_id and sdu.lead_state = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user_info sui on sdu.user_id = sui.uid

SELECT sdu.department_id, sd.name AS departmentName, sdu.user_id, sui.user_name, sd.code FROM sys_department_user sdu INNER JOIN sys_user_info sui ON sdu.user_id = sui.uid INNER JOIN sys_department sd ON sdu.department_id = sd.id WHERE sui.delete_state=1 AND sdu.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT sui.uid AS userId, sui.code, sui.user_name, sui.mobile FROM sys_user_info sui INNER JOIN sys_department_user sdu ON sdu.user_id = sui.uid WHERE sui.delete_state=1 AND sdu.department_id = #{deptId}
